title: Order-to-Cash Split-Shipment & Margin-Floor Policy
content: When a port or carrier disruption threatens a Tier-1 customer SLA penalty, compare regional WMS split-shipment vs. air-freight expedite. Any expedite exceeding 65% of avoided SLA penalty requires mandatory VP Operations escalation before approval.

title: Atomic Multi-System Saga & WMS Compensation Rollback
content: Never commit WMS inventory reservation independently from Carrier booking and ERP order updates. Execute all 3 writes inside Google Cloud Workflows with an idempotency_key; if Carrier API fails, automatically invoke release_wms_reservation to prevent orphaned inventory.

title: EDI-214 Duplicate Webhook & Proof-of-Delivery Verification
content: Always cross-check late carrier EDI-214 delay notices against signed Proof-of-Delivery (POD) timestamps in WMS/ERP before dispatching replacement stock.
